`abstract class RenderBridgeContractSuite`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.contract` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [RenderBridgeContractSuite.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/contract/RenderBridgeContractSuite.java)

The contract tests of a render bridge, run on your snapshot backend in a few seconds.

## Description

Extend it in the tests of your backend and return your snapshot backend from `createBackend()`; every test then runs on your render bridge.
Each test name states the rule it checks; the rules are those of the render contract.

## Learn more

- [The suites](/build/testing-a-backend/#the-suites)
- [Render bridge](/build/bridges/render/#guarantees)
